title: Guest Payment of a Declined Installment 1 — Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Paying a declined installment 1 — guest self-service payment reference

## Policy statement

When the collection of installment 1 at confirmation of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category has been declined and the stay, still confirmed or checked in, is inside the failed-payment grace period, the guest pays installment 1 from their own payment method and it is recorded as installment 1 of the stay.

Installment 1 carries the guest service fee and occupancy tax attributable to the amounts it collects.

| Condition on the stay's records | State required |
|---|---|
| Collection of installment 1 at confirmation | declined |
| Stay status | confirmed or checked in |
| Failed-payment grace period | still running |

## Paying installment 1 — `pay_first_installment_26275b3d`

**Situation of use and capability.** The guest pays installment 1 of a stay from their own payment method when the automatic collection of that installment at confirmation was declined by their card. One call records one collection on the stay's money ledger, filed as installment 1, for the amount given; the amount then shows as collected on the stay and the guest sees the payment on their reservation. The receipt confirms the collection.

**How it is invoked.** `pay_first_installment_26275b3d` is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it from their own payment method.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `stay_id` | the reference number of the stay (reservation) whose installment 1 the guest pays, as returned by the stay lookup for that guest | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount of installment 1 the guest pays | a positive amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places; a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places when booked |

**Return.** A receipt listing `collection_reference` (the reference number of the new collection record), `stay_id` (the stay paid on), `installment_number` (always 1), `amount` (US dollars with 2 decimal places, the amount collected), `posted_at` (the moment the collection was recorded, in the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) and a status, which is always "collected" when the payment went through.
